Metadata consistently identifies public LeetCode problem 395 and its Python longestSubstring surface. The Reference preserves contiguous-substring semantics, the requirement that every present character occur at least k times, both source examples with explanations, lowercase input, the nonempty length bound, and all three constraints.

The hash-bound public Reference remains source-fidelity verified, including both source examples in order with complete explanations, the contiguous-substring objective, frequency threshold semantics, lowercase alphabet, and all three constraints.
